title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Exodus 12: the first Passover, the blood on the doors, the death of the firstborn and the departure from Egypt.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say this month would be for Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said this month would be the beginning of months, the first month of the year for them.

answers.text: The first month of the year
The last month of the year

questions.text: On which day of the month was every man to take a lamb for his household?
questions.explanation: On the tenth day of this month every man was to take a lamb, a lamb for a household.

questions.text: What kind of lamb were they to take?
questions.explanation: The lamb had to be without defect, a male a year old, taken from the sheep or from the goats.

answers.text: A male a year old, without defect

questions.text: Where were they to put some of the lamb's blood?
questions.explanation: They were to put some of the blood on the two door posts and on the lintel of the houses where they ate it.

answers.text: On the roof and the outer walls
On the threshold and the floor
On the altar in front of the house
On the two door posts and the lintel

questions.text: How were they to eat the meat of the lamb?
questions.explanation: They were to eat the meat that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

answers.text: Boiled in water, with leavened bread and wine
Roasted, with unleavened bread and bitter herbs
Raw, with salt and fresh bread
Dried in the sun, with honey and figs

questions.text: How were they to be dressed while eating the Passover?
questions.explanation: They were to eat it with a belt on the waist, sandals on the feet and a staff in the hand, and eat it in haste.

answers.text: With belt, sandals and staff ready

questions.text: What did Moses tell the elders to dip in the blood in the basin?
questions.explanation: Moses told them to take a bunch of hyssop, dip it in the blood in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts.

questions.text: From where to where did the children of Israel travel when they left?
questions.explanation: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides children.

questions.text: How long had the children of Israel lived in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

questions.text: According to the ordinance of the Passover, what must not be done to the lamb?
questions.explanation: It had to be eaten in one house, none of the meat could be carried outside, and none of its bones could be broken.

answers.text: It may not be killed at evening
It may not be shared with a neighbor
None of its bones may be broken
